messages:
sofia: heads up — just pushed a small housekeeping deploy that prunes old keystore entries. seeing ~5% of eu-west ingress mTLS handshakes fail since the roll. rolling back now, but want eyes: may be RBAC -> KMS unwrap issue. any quick triage tips? :eyes:
ben: grabbing proxy logs now. seeing a lot of these: `ERR TLS handshake: missing intermediate for CN=svc-auth` and repeated `KMS_DECRYPT_DENY key_id=projects/prod/locations/eu-west/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/keystore`
irene: can you paste a sample audit log line from the time window? specifically need the IAM decision for the pruner SA.
sofia: pasted snippet from audit (redacted):
```
{"protoPayload": {"methodName":"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt","authorizationInfo":[{"granted":false,"permission":"cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt"}],"serviceName":"cloudkms.googleapis.com","resourceName":"projects/prod/locations/eu-west/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/keystore/cryptoKeyVersions/1"}}
```
drake: I rolled the RBAC change earlier today — I moved the pruner to a narrower role `roles/keystore.pruner` to remove write perms elsewhere. looks like that role can list keys but not call KMS Decrypt. pruner SA = `keystore-pruner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
sofia: that matches. pruner can list but can't unwrap wrapped cert blobs, so intermediate certs never get populated -> proxy rejects chain.
irene: quick mitigation path: regrant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` (or `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`) to the pruner SA scoped to the eu-west key ring only, run an unwrap backfill (dry-run) and watch. example backfill command: `./scripts/keystore_unwrap_backfill --region eu-west --dry-run`
ben: also recommend enabling an aggregated alert for KMS_DECRYPT_DENY over threshold per region. opening a tracking ticket and adding a SIEM rule. @oncall please escalate if spike > 2% handshake errors.
sec-bot: :rotating_light: incident created (INC-2026-eu-mtls-pruner) by sofia — severity: medium — current status: triage
drake: I'll push the role grant to infra-iam (eu-west only) and patch the pruner to run a permissive canary (10% keys) before full backfill. plan to canary for 20m and monitor handshake success metrics.
sofia: plan ack: 1) grant short-lived kms:decrypt to keystore-pruner-sa in eu-west 2) run dry-run backfill -> verify no failures 3) run canary unwrap (10%) 4) roll to 100% if success. rollback criteria: if handshake failure rate > 1% absolute increase in 30m window we revert. i'll execute step 1 now. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy started: id=deploy-1774109876-01 -> role-grant patch to infra-iam (eu-west). status: in-progress
ben: after role grant, we should capture all `KMS_DECRYPT_DENY` audit events and attach them to the incident plus correlate with proxy trace ids. that will help root cause and postmortem.
irene: I'll open PR to infra-iam to make the grant expire in 48 hours (temporary mitigation) and track design doc for a least-priv wrapper service that performs unwraps with audited HSM calls.
drake: canary kicked off. initial telemetry looks promising — handshake error rate down to baseline in the canary slice. i'll let it run 20 more minutes and then expand.
sofia: thanks. followups: - ben, own the audit extraction and SIEM rule - irene, land the infra-iam expiring grant PR - drake, own canary rollout and final rollback decision. i'll update the incident once we finish full backfill.
sofia: tagging for compliance: we should note this RBAC change in access-matrix and add an entry to change log so auditors see the short-lived grant rationale.
ben: noted, will update docs and attach INC-2026.
sofia: closing loop: if anyone sees KMS denies from other regions after this, call it out here immediately. thanks all :pray:
